data.one_liner: CacheManager implementation for Firebase Storage using gs:// keys.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CacheManager implementation and FirebaseHttpFileService specifically for Firebase Storage. It uses gs:// paths as keys and translates them to HTTPS URLs to fetch and cache files.
use_when: You need to cache files fetched from Firebase Storage in your Flutter application.
You want to use gs:// paths as keys for your cached files.
avoid_when: You are using standard HTTP URLs rather than Firebase Storage gs:// references.
You require a general-purpose local database or key-value store not tied to Firebase.
strengths: Seamless integration with flutter_cache_manager and firebase_storage.
Supports retry options and Wasm compatibility.
weaknesses: Limited to Firebase Storage use cases.
Depends on specific external packages like firebase_storage and flutter_cache_manager.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Firebase Storage and importing the package alongside firebase_storage and flutter_cache_manager.
